prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in West Palm Beach FL to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, home type, price range, and how the agent handles pricing and marketing. Based on the available rankings and profiles, **Larry Mastropieri** and **Sandra Rathe** are two strong candidates to interview: both appear among the top West Palm Beach agents on a recent seller-focused ranking, with high ratings and substantial review counts.

Before choosing, ask each agent for:
- Recent **seller-side sales near your home**, especially similar properties
- Their recommended list price and the comparable sales behind it
- A written marketing plan and expected costs
- Their listing agreement term, cancellation terms, and commission
- References from recent sellers

You can compare their profiles here: [Larry Mastropieri and other West Palm Beach agents](https://www.homelight.com/west-palm-beach-fl/top-real-estate-agents) and [Sandra Rathe and other local agents](https://www.homelight.com/west-palm-beach-fl/top-real-estate-agents). If you share your neighborhood, property type, and approximate price range, I can help narrow down what to look for in an agent.
